subtitle: "AlphaGenome and LS-GKM | real genomic loci"

  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true

params:
  alphagenome_metrics_path: null
  lsgkm_metrics_path: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,
                      fig.width=10, fig.height=7, dpi=120)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(gt); library(scales)})
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
          theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom"))
model_colors <- c(AlphaGenome="#0072B2", `LS-GKM`="#D55E00")
```

```{r inputs, include=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$alphagenome_metrics_path) || is.null(params$lsgkm_metrics_path))
  stop("alphagenome_metrics_path and lsgkm_metrics_path are required")

read_metrics <- function(path) {
  read.delim(normalizePath(path, mustWork=TRUE), sep="\t",
             stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
}

x <- bind_rows(read_metrics(params$alphagenome_metrics_path),
               read_metrics(params$lsgkm_metrics_path)) |>
  mutate(Model=recode(model, alphagenome="AlphaGenome", lsgkm="LS-GKM"),
         Model=factor(Model, levels=c("AlphaGenome", "LS-GKM")),
         Split=factor(recode(split, train_100="Full training pool",
                             validation="Validation", test="Test"),
                      levels=c("Full training pool", "Validation", "Test")),
         ranking_error=1-auroc)

if (nrow(x) != 126) stop("Expected 126 EVS metric rows; found ", nrow(x))
if (!all(x$dataset == "evs")) stop("Metrics include a non-EVS dataset")
if (!all(x$negative_kind == "real")) stop("EVS report expects real data only")
if (n_distinct(x$Model) != 2) stop("Expected both AlphaGenome and LS-GKM metrics")

metric_limits <- function(v) {
  span <- diff(range(v, na.rm=TRUE)); pad <- max(span*.08, .002)
  range(v, na.rm=TRUE) + c(-pad, pad)
}

learning_plot <- function(metric, title, label) {
  ggplot(x, aes(n_training_total, .data[[metric]], color=Model, group=Model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth=.85) + geom_point(size=1.8) +
    facet_grid(Split ~ Model, scales="free_x") +
    scale_color_manual(values=model_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels=comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(.02,.03))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=metric_limits(x[[metric]])) +
    labs(title=title, x="Cumulative training observations", y=label, color="Model") +
    guides(color="none")
}
```

# Scope and interpretation

This report compares native enhancer-versus-silencer (EVS) performance for
AlphaGenome and LS-GKM. Enhancers have label 1 and silencers have label 0; no
generated negative backgrounds are used. Chr1 is validation, chr2 is held-out
test, and training checkpoints cumulatively add chr3 through chrX.

Each panel contains one EVS trajectory. The columns place the two model families
side by side, while the rows show the full training pool, validation, and test
evaluations on common metric-axis ranges.

# AUROC learning curves

```{r auroc}
learning_plot("auroc", "Native EVS AUROC", "AUROC")
```

# Average-precision learning curves

```{r auprc}
learning_plot("auprc", "Native EVS average precision", "Average Precision")
```

# AUROC ranking-error curves

```{r ranking}
learning_plot("ranking_error", "Native EVS AUROC ranking error", "1 - AUROC")
```

# Full-training comparison

```{r full}
x |> filter(checkpoint_index == max(checkpoint_index)) |>
  select(Model, Split, n_training_total, n_evaluation_total, auroc, auprc) |>
  rename(`Training observations`=n_training_total,
         `Evaluation observations`=n_evaluation_total,
         AUROC=auroc, `Average Precision`=auprc) |>
  arrange(Model, Split) |>
  gt(groupname_col="Model") |>
  tab_header(title="Final chr3-through-chrX native EVS models") |>
  fmt_integer(columns=c(`Training observations`, `Evaluation observations`)) |>
  fmt_number(columns=c(AUROC, `Average Precision`), decimals=3)
```

# Reproducibility notes

- Both methods use the same chromosome-defined EVS training and evaluation sets.
- The report uses real enhancer and silencer loci only; it has no synthetic-background branch.
- All three evaluation splits use common y-axis ranges within each metric.
- Test data are used only for final evaluation.
- AlphaGenome uses logits from validation-selected frozen-encoder heads; LS-GKM uses continuous gkm-SVM decision scores.

Rendered at `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")`.
